subject: Re: Redwood Inference — quick sync re: scaling + rate limits (booked from usage signal)

body:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Petrova <elena@northstar.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Mar 3, 2025 at 4:12 PM PT
Subject: Redwood Inference — quick sync re: scaling + rate limits (booked from usage signal)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for raising your hand on the “Contact sales” form earlier today.

We also saw a usage signal on your self-serve project (sustained spend growth + repeated 429/rate-limit hits over the last ~2 weeks). If helpful, we can walk through:
- what’s driving the spikes (concurrency + burst patterns)
- options to remove rate limiting / stabilize latency (Dedicated capacity, quota policy, and batching/caching tuning)
- what a short PoC would look like + success criteria

Could you do either of these times?
- Tue 3/4 @ 10:00–10:30am PT
- Tue 3/4 @ 1:30–2:00pm PT

If neither works, send 2–3 windows and your timezone and we’ll lock something in.

(Apologies if this is redundant — we’re piloting a new process that routes high-intent product signals into HubSpot so we can respond quickly.)

Best,
Avery

Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Perfect — invite sent for Tue 3/4, 10:00–10:30am PT.

Zoom: https://redwoodinference.zoom.us/j/93455120817

Quick pre-read / to keep the call tight:

1) Agenda (30 min)
- 5 min: confirm workload + targets (p95 latency, throughput, regions)
- 10 min: what we’re seeing (burst/concurrency, quota/rate limit patterns)
- 10 min: recommendations (Dedicated vs Hosted tuning; what changes immediately)
- 5 min: next steps + owners

2) Mutual Action Plan (shared doc)
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nSxMAP-Redwood-Northstar-28741/edit

If you can add a sentence or two ahead of time on:
- what you consider “good enough” latency (p95) and any hard SLOs
- your peak concurrency (rough range is fine)
- whether data residency is a requirement (US-only, EU, etc.)

we can come in with a more concrete recommendation.

See you tomorrow,
Avery

Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — quick sync re: scaling + rate limits (booked from usage signal)

Thanks Avery — added a few notes in the doc.

Summary:
- p95 target: 900ms end-to-end for our main chat endpoint
- spikes: 4–6x during US mornings (product launches); we see a bunch of 429s and then a backlog
- we’re currently pinned to your hosted tier, would consider dedicated if it smooths this out
- US-only is fine for now; we may need EU later this year

See you at 10am PT.

Samir
